avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces azithromycin plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal supplement

avoid_supplements.name: Antiarrhythmic supplements (QT-prolonging agents)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Azithromycin prolongs QT interval; concurrent use significantly increases risk of torsades de pointes and arrhythmias
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; use alternative antibiotic if possible

avoid_supplements.name: Magnesium/Aluminum antacid supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Divalent cations chelate azithromycin, reducing absorption by 50% when taken concurrently
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by at least 2 hours; take azithromycin first

caution_supplements.name: Zinc supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Divalent cation may reduce azithromycin absorption if taken simultaneously
caution_supplements.action: Separate dosing by 2+ hours or monitor for reduced efficacy

caution_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce azithromycin absorption through chelation; effect less significant than Mg/Al
caution_supplements.action: Take azithromycin 2 hours before or 6 hours after calcium supplement

caution_supplements.name: Iron supplements
caution_supplements.action: Separate dosing by 2+ hours; monitor clinical response

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Fat delays azithromycin gastric emptying and may affect bioavailability depending on formulation; affects patient compliance with timing
avoid_foods.action: Take azithromycin on empty stomach (1 hour before or 2 hours after meals) for optimal absorption

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor may modestly increase azithromycin plasma concentration and QT prolongation risk
caution_foods.action: Limit grapefruit consumption; monitor for adverse effects (nausea, QT changes)

caution_foods.name: Dairy products (with immediate dosing)
caution_foods.mechanism: Calcium content may slightly reduce absorption if co-ingested; effect is minor with time separation
caution_foods.action: Avoid taking azithromycin with milk/yogurt; safe if separated by 2+ hours

monitoring_notes: Monitor for QT prolongation risk, especially in elderly patients or those with cardiac comorbidities; counsel patients on timing relative to meals and supplements to maximize bioavailability and minimize drug interactions. Baseline ECG recommended in high-risk patients.
